items.title: Benjie White Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who was the guitar player again? Was that Mark Smith? [INTERVIEWEE] No, no, no, that wasn't. That was Jinx DeBall or Eugene DeBall.

ctx.x: We had, it was a funny thing, we had a banjo, a guitar, two violins, and Guy Lyman on this contraption he had, it wasn't a drum, it was just a box with a bunch of plates on it that he would beat on.
Who was the guitar player again? Was that Mark Smith?
No, no, no, that wasn't. That was Jinx DeBall or Eugene DeBall.
